assessments.reasoning: The publisher-governing acquisition came from GNU's fdl-1.2.txt and matched the claim's 20,394-byte plaintext provenance. The four verified ranges contain the opening permission, §1 definition, §2 copying conditions and Addendum respectively. Reading their subjects separately resolves the apparent tension between permission to modify a covered work and the prohibition on changing the instrument.

challenge.method: Tested an unchanged copy of the GNU plaintext, a copy with the Addendum edited to remove the later-version option, and the SPDX-generated license text. Compared the Addendum's sample with a hypothetical holder's notice selecting 1.2 alone, then checked the later-version rule in §10.
challenge.results: The unchanged plaintext satisfies the opening permission. Editing even the sample inside the instrument changes the copy. The SPDX representation also differs from the pinned plaintext, including a postal address where the GNU capture gives an FSF URL. For a hypothetical 1.2-only work, the complete instrument retains its Addendum and the work retains its separate edition-only notice. If the holder instead authorizes 1.2 or later, §10 permits choosing 1.2 or a later nondraft FSF edition. The Addendum example alone cannot supply that choice for a work.

limitations: Revision 1 concerns the complete publisher plaintext. A work's actual authorized notice separately establishes its edition choice and designated features.
The governing and heading acquisitions returned the same GNU file. They supply one publisher origin.
reasoning: The opening of the FSF's GNU FDL 1.2 plaintext gives everyone permission to copy and distribute the license document verbatim and expressly excludes changes. Section 1 defines the covered work by its copyright holder's notice. Section 2 requires copies of that work to reproduce the license, copyright notices and applicability notice, without added conditions or technical measures that obstruct reading or further copying. The Addendum illustrates how an author can supply a work notice alongside a copy of the license.
